_README: Deliberate Setlist removals, acknowledged so the health-check guard passes. One entry per ShowID. 'entries' are the exact strings removed; 'why' must say why they were not songs. Anything removed WITHOUT an entry here blocks the push.

38936833f4cd.why: Provenance lines from the header of the folder's info.txt, imported into Setlist as if they were songs. The real setlist is the disc's 18 numbered tracks, which the field now holds; two of those tracks were missing while this junk was present.

2cc4ba6da8d1.why: Not a setlist. The three words are an English sentence fragment split on spaces - almost certainly a note such as "Didn't figure out" written into the field and later delimited. No setlist is known for this show.
